scope: Two familiar registered training families; four fresh attempts per arm

verification.reason: The parser lazily imported RLM, which is absent from the CPU tokenizer/review environment.

child_components: One candidate family completed the same valid failed-check/repair/passing-check/finish child sequence twice. Parent assignment printed no completion feedback, then the parent delegated again instead of applying/testing the returned proposal. The other candidate family repeated an incorrect caller check and returned an invalid patch; it did not complete a child repair.
transport_result: Six explicit bare helper cells executed without altering their raw model responses, under the existing phase and call limits. This demonstrates transport execution, not combined learned improvement.
limitations: Familiar training-family results do not establish generalization.
Functional net2of4 hides one gained and one lost individual pass; ordinary tested improves1to2of2, genuine child-tested remains0of2.
All historical comparisons are descriptive only. Fresh BASE outputs were used.
Generated token IDs and complete trajectories were not replayed; prompt/context/output counts and exact recorded checks were verified.

Candidate weight binding and server mode code were verified; this trial did not persist per-request mode or independently rerun actual LoRA enable flags. Different child goals prevent attributing first child output differences solely to the adapter.
